description: In handle_mdn_send (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs lines 239-252), the CRLF checks for mdn_gateway and original_message_id have no comment explaining why client-supplied values for spec-marked (server-set) fields are validated. The spec (draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2) marks both fields as '(server-set)', but §2 also states finalRecipient 'if specified by the client ... the server will use the client provided value' and there is no equivalent explicit statement for mdn_gateway/original_message_id. The fields are accepted in the request object (the Mdn struct is shared for both send and parse). A brief comment should explain: these fields are server-set in the normal case but are accepted from the client to allow overrides; since the values flow into RFC 5322 headers, CRLF injection must still be checked even though the server would normally populate them.
title: mdn.rs: mdn_gateway/original_message_id CRLF checks lack rationale comment
